title: External services
intro: Everything TravStats does not do itself: flight data, maps, photos, AI, sync and mail. Here you decide what the instance uses and what accounts may set up themselves. New services stay off until you switch them on.
noResults: No service matches the search and filter.

admin.title: Allow {{name}}?
admin.intro: When the local parser finds nothing, TravStats sends the text of an import to this provider. Read first, then confirm.
admin.whatText: Text from e-mails and PDFs, at most 12,000 characters per import. No photos, no passwords, no other entries.
admin.whenText: Only during an import, only when the local parser has no answer.
admin.whoText: You allow the provider for the instance. Each account confirms the approval itself before its first import.
admin.checkbox: I understand which data goes to {{name}} and allow the provider for this instance.

account.title: Send your imports to {{name}}?
account.intro: Your instance allows {{name}} as a second chance for bookings the local parser does not understand. You decide whether your documents go there.
account.goes: What leaves: the text of the e-mail or PDF, at most 12,000 characters.
account.stays: What does not leave: photos, passwords, your other entries.
account.when: When: only during an import, only when the local parser finds nothing.
account.withdraw: Withdraw: any time here; from then on nothing goes to {{name}}.
account.checkbox: I agree that my imports go to {{name}} in these cases.

instance.title: Provided by the instance
instance.note: Only an admin can switch or change these under Administration › External services.

common.remoteOptIn: Treat the remote server as a cloud service

railTimetables.contact: Contact for the rail lookups (e-mail or URL)

airlabs.name: AirLabs
airlabs.why: Provides departure, arrival, aircraft and status when you enter a flight number or a flight is refreshed.
airlabs.cost: The free tier is enough for a private logbook; larger plans cost monthly.
airlabs.quota: 1,000 requests per month on the free tier.
airlabs.dataOut: Flight number and date. No names, no booking data.

aviationstack.name: Aviationstack
aviationstack.purpose: Flight search as a second source
aviationstack.why: Steps in when AirLabs does not know a flight.
aviationstack.cost: Free entry tier, monthly above that.

aerodatabox.name: AeroDataBox
aerodatabox.purpose: Flights up to a year back
aerodatabox.why: Finds past flights that the live providers no longer know.
aerodatabox.quota: 600 units per month on the basic tier; TravStats reads the balance.
aerodatabox.quotaLine: 600 units / month free · balance according to RapidAPI

aeroapi.name: FlightAware AeroAPI
aeroapi.purpose: Status, delay, gate; optionally real flight tracks
aeroapi.why: Exact times, delays, gates and cancellations for your flights; on request the real flight track after landing.
aeroapi.cost: Paid per request. Personal plan: 5 USD credit per month, 10 USD with your own ADS-B receiver (feeder).
aeroapi.quota: TravStats keeps to the monthly budget and stops before it.
aeroapi.quotaLine: 10 USD / month · stops before the limit

opensky.name: OpenSky Network
opensky.why: Recognises the aircraft and the flown route from open ADS-B data.
opensky.quota: Daily rate limit; contributors of data get more.
opensky.dataOut: Flight number or aircraft identifier and period.

adsblol.name: adsb.lol
adsblol.purpose: Aircraft of a flight that is currently airborne
adsblol.why: Adds registration and aircraft type while the flight is in the air.
adsblol.quota: No fixed quota; TravStats asks at most once per second.
adsblol.dataOut: Flight number or identifier, today's flights only.

adsbx.name: ADS-B Exchange
adsbx.why: Second live source next to adsb.lol, only for flights in the air.
adsbx.cost: Paid RapidAPI plan. A feeder UUID is not an API key.
adsbx.quota: According to the plan you booked.
adsbx.dataOut: Flight number or identifier, today's flights only.

openrouteservice.name: OpenRouteService
openrouteservice.purpose: Road routes for roadtrips and tours
openrouteservice.why: Calculates the driven route between stops.
openrouteservice.cost: Free up to the daily quota.

graphhopper.name: GraphHopper
graphhopper.why: Replacement in case OpenRouteService does not fit.
graphhopper.cost: Free up to the daily quota.

railTimetables.name: Rail timetables
railTimetables.purpose: Transitous and db-rest for train rides
railTimetables.why: Finds train connections and line paths when you enter a train ride.
railTimetables.quota: db-rest shares about 100 requests per minute with all users.

googlePlaces.name: Google Places
googlePlaces.purpose: Last tier of place search, Maps takeout
googlePlaces.why: Finds places the open geocoders do not know and resolves Google Maps exports.
googlePlaces.cost: Billed per request by Google's price list; Google grants a monthly credit.
googlePlaces.quota: According to your Google Cloud account.
googlePlaces.getKeyLabel: Key in the Google Cloud Console

geocoder.name: Photon & Nominatim
geocoder.cost: Free; your own server is possible.
geocoder.quota: Nominatim: at most 1 request per second.
geocoder.alwaysOnWhy: Place search, address entry and coordinates run on it; without it no form could find a place. To avoid the public servers, enter your own addresses under "Expert".

selfHostedRouting.name: Self-hosted routing servers
selfHostedRouting.why: Routes without a third-party service, e.g. rail lines from your own OpenRailRouting.

immich.name: Immich
immich.purpose: Attach photo albums to trips, photo-journey scan
immich.why: Shows albums from your Immich in trips or imports the pictures.
immich.dataOut: Stays between TravStats and your Immich.
immich.getKeyLabel: Create an API key in Immich
immich.adminPurpose: The instance's connection for the nightly photo scan; accounts connect their own Immich

strava.name: Strava
strava.why: Fetches hikes and bike tours as tours.
strava.quota: Strava limits requests per 15 minutes and per day for the whole app.
strava.dataOut: Strava sends activities to TravStats, not the other way round.
strava.adminPurpose: The instance's Strava app (client ID and secret); accounts connect their own Strava through it

ollama.name: Ollama (local)
ollama.purpose: Reads bookings from e-mails and PDFs, inside your own network
ollama.why: Understands booking confirmations that no template knows.

openai.name: OpenAI
openai.purpose: Cloud parser when Ollama finds nothing
openai.why: Second chance for bookings the local parser does not understand.
openai.dataOut: Text of the import, up to 12,000 characters. Only after consent.
openai.costShort: Paid per token through your OpenAI account.

anthropic.name: Anthropic Claude
anthropic.purpose: Cloud parser when Ollama finds nothing
anthropic.why: Second chance for bookings the local parser does not understand.
anthropic.dataOut: Text of the import, up to 12,000 characters. Only after consent.
anthropic.costShort: Paid per token through your Anthropic account.

gemini.name: Google Gemini
gemini.purpose: Cloud parser when Ollama finds nothing
gemini.why: Second chance for bookings the local parser does not understand.
gemini.dataOut: Text of the import, up to 12,000 characters. Only after consent.

customLlm.name: Custom AI endpoint
customLlm.why: For any service that speaks the OpenAI interface.
customLlm.dataOut: Text of the import. A remote server needs consent as well.

openData.name: Weather, elevation & Wikipedia
openData.why: Weather for travel days, elevation profiles, info and pictures for places.
openData.quota: Fair use; TravStats caches the answers.

logos.name: Airline & operator logos
logos.why: Shows logos of airlines, shipping lines and rail companies.
logos.cost: Free sources are free; logostream is a paid service.

fx.name: Exchange rates
fx.alwaysOnWhy: Every conversion into your currency uses the ECB rates; only a currency and a date leave the server. Only the fallback source for currencies the ECB does not publish can be switched off.

webdav.name: WebDAV
webdav.purpose: Backups and exports to a share
webdav.why: Stores backups and exports on your NAS or in a cloud.
webdav.dataOut: The whole backup, transferred encrypted; the target must be trustworthy.
webdav.adminPurpose: The instance's backups and exports to a share; accounts may add their own targets

smtp.name: E-mail (SMTP)
smtp.why: Without mail there are no invitations and no password reset.

push.name: Push relay
push.why: Forwards notices to the Companion app.

federation.name: Federation
federation.purpose: Trips and leaderboard with other TravStats servers
federation.why: Shares trips and comparison figures with friends on other servers.
federation.dataOut: Only what an account explicitly shares; the leaderboard carries totals only.

usageStats.name: Usage statistics
usageStats.why: Helps to see which features are used.
usageStats.dataOut: Anonymous counters, no trips, no names.

updatesTemplates.name: Update check & templates
updatesTemplates.why: Reports new TravStats versions and loads templates for booking mails.
updatesTemplates.dataOut: Only the request itself, no data from your logbook.

dawarich.name: Dawarich
dawarich.why: Reads your location history to suggest stays and trips.

aisstream.name: AISStream
aisstream.purpose: Live position of a ferry or ship
aisstream.why: Shows where the ship is right now when someone asks, on a ferry crossing. Without a key the display stays off.
aisstream.quota: At most two simultaneous connections for the whole instance.
aisstream.dataOut: The vessel identifier (MMSI), only when someone requests the position.

alwaysOn.label: Always on – this service cannot be switched off.
